Frequently Asked Questions

I've never worked out before. Is this safe?

Completely. Our AI includes detailed form tips for every exercise and focuses on low-impact, beginner-friendly movements. Always start slow and listen to your body.

How often should I work out?

We recommend 2-3 sessions per week with at least one rest day between workouts. Consistency beats intensity when you're starting out.

What if an exercise feels too hard?

Every plan includes simpler alternatives. You can also use the 'notes' field to mention any concerns, and the AI will adapt accordingly.
